principle: Mastery is preserved; remediation targets evidence of unfinished skills rather than punishing the learner.

foundation.recommended_when: skill evidence is below 60% or prerequisite weakness is detected

core.purpose: direct corrective practice on the missed course skill
core.recommended_when: skill evidence is 60-79% or an isolated misconception is detected

extended.recommended_when: skill is mastered or learner requests challenge

recommendation_contract.fallback: Local course resources must remain sufficient when NAIB is unavailable.

student_recovery_loop: show exact missed item and skill
explain misconception without exposing hidden answer logic before submission
permit return to lesson and assignment
permit repeat practice and quiz attempts
unlock progression when mastery is at least 80%
safety_rules: never erase a previously earned mastery record
never lower the 80% progression standard silently
never require NAIB or an external service for course completion
never recommend a resource without a traceable skill association
preserve attempt history and correction evidence
